name: Node drain on local storage
note: What we saw in the lab, and what K2 does about it.

steps.label: evict (kubectl drain)
steps.say: Run on kind: the Sandbox pod was evicted from its node.

steps.label: schedule replacement
steps.say: The controller for the pod tries to place it again.

steps.label: Pending: volume node affinity
steps.say: Seen live: local-path volumes belong to one node, so the pod can only return to the drained node.

steps.label: host away > 5 min
steps.say: K2 notices through its own host link, not through Kubernetes status.

steps.label: portable? move via home sync
steps.say: A portable agent is moved with the previous flow. A pinned agent waits for its node. With Longhorn, the volume follows the pod instead.
